scope: Targeted Phase 5 extraction from the six official The Brothers' War Magic Story pages that pack_b does not cite: Episodes 2-3 (the past timeline) and Chapters 2-5 (the present-day Dominaria timeline). One or two claims per page; not an exhaustive reading. PRELIMINARY_RESEARCH; not owner approved.

claims.subject: urza

quotes.quote: All Tawnos knew he owed to Urza's instruction.
From clever toymaker to master artificer, Urza's steady hand had molded Tawnos as skillfully and distantly as Urza had shaped the face of the world.

claims.summary: Urza's instruction turned Tawnos from a clever toymaker into a master artificer.

claims.subject: tawnos

quotes.quote: Tawnos had sketched original plans for Penregon's civils, but the very theory of their design was based off machines Urza had devised—machines meant only to burn, wreck, and ruin.

claims.summary: Tawnos designed Penregon's civil machines, based on the theory of Urza's war machines.

claims.subject: sanwell

quotes.quote: Kroog died on a crimson morning.

To Sanwell, it sounded like a festival day, only the crowds cheered in a minor key, and the booms and reports were not fireworks exploding, and the smoke rising over the city stank of burning industry and steaming bricks.

claims.summary: The pilot Sanwell is in Kroog on the morning the city is destroyed.

claims.subject: saheeli

quotes.quote: Saheeli stepped back from her latest version of the Temporal Anchor, coil-shaped like the aether whorls that danced high in Kaladesh's skies.
In contrast to the original device detailed in Jodah's plans, Saheeli's Temporal Anchor did not transmit matter through the time stream.

claims.summary: Saheeli builds the Temporal Anchor from Jodah's plans, altered to project a spirit back in time rather than matter.

claims.subject: kaya

quotes.quote: By extending her ghostform over the coffin with Teferi inside, Kaya could render him entirely incorporeal, perfect for the anchor to do its work.

claims.summary: Kaya uses her ghostform to make Teferi incorporeal so the Temporal Anchor can send his spirit back in time.

claims.subject: sheoldred

quotes.quote: On Dominaria, Sheoldred had discovered a way to interfere with Karn's planeswalking.

claims.summary: Sheoldred found a way to interfere with Karn's planeswalking on Dominaria.

claims.subject: phyrexians

quotes.quote: Karn did not speak, did not complain while hooks and razors—the Suture Bishops' preferred exploratory appendages—prodded his mangled body for seams that would facilitate his dissection.
Tezzeret waited for any kind of movement from Karn.

claims.summary: The captive Karn is examined for dissection by Phyrexian Suture Bishops while Tezzeret watches.
claims.limitation: Captivity is shown, not stated; the location (New Phyrexia) is not graded here.

claims.subject: elspeth_tirel

quotes.quote: Elspeth accepted command of this mechanical garrison at Teferi's request.
Sleep had not come easy to Elspeth since she arrived on Dominaria almost a week ago.

claims.summary: On Dominaria, Elspeth commands a mechanical garrison at Teferi's request.

claims.subject: nissa_revane

quotes.quote: Nissa had spent days on Ravnica with Chandra learning all she could about who and what the Phyrexians were.

claims.summary: Nissa spent days on Ravnica with Chandra learning about the Phyrexians before coming to Dominaria.

remaining: Episodes 2-3 and Chapters 2-5 have one or two claims each; the Penregon and Kroog plots and the present-day preparations are only lightly modelled
Urabrask and the rebel Phyrexians (mentioned in Chapter 5) are not graded
Pack_b's existing claims for the other four pages are unchanged
